# Traçando um histograma de 'winpercent'
ggplotly(
  ggplot(candy_rankings, aes(x = winpercent)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = stat(density)),  fill="black") +
  geom_density( color = "red",  alpha=0.3, fill="red") +
  labs(title = "Histograma e Densidade") +
  theme_minimal()
)
